title: Maldives Opposition Eyes Sweeping Constitutional Overhaul
gist: The Maldivian Democratic Party's October 1-3 congress consolidated leadership under chairperson Mohamed Nasheed and endorsed a sweeping constitutional reform program, Bodu Badhalu, by 520 of 563 delegates. The excerpt is truncated.

insights.claim: The MDP abolished the posts of party president and vice president at its fifth National Congress, consolidating leadership under the chairperson, currently former President Mohamed Nasheed.
insights.speaker: Mimrah Abdul Ghafoor
insights.so_what: Leadership consolidation sets up Nasheed as the opposition's central figure.

insights.claim: Delegates endorsed the sweeping constitutional reform program Bodu Badhalu ('Big Change') by 520 of 563 delegates present, the congress's most consequential decision.
insights.speaker: Mimrah Abdul Ghafoor
insights.so_what: Constitutional overhaul agenda is a Maldives political-risk factor to monitor ahead of elections.
